events.title: emergent_middle_power_alignment
events.description: A coalition of European member states, alarmed by repeated denials of frontier access and semiconductor coercion, begins informal coordination with Japan and South Korea to create a mutual access pact for AI development resources and secure supply-chain nodes. The move is framed as resilience-building but signals a shift toward strategic autonomy from U.S. tech policy. It gains traction due to the EU's upstream leverage in lithography and materials, even if sovereignty remains low.

events.title: Backlash Turns Physical
events.description: Protest against AI infrastructure moves from petitions and hearings to direct action: occupations at data centre sites, sabotage of grid connections, and in the harder cases injury. Policing it costs the Union more than the damage does.

portfolio.name: Mandate AI-Resilient Critical Infrastructure Retrofit
portfolio.description: Require all operators of essential services to complete a certified upgrade of legacy systems to AI-resilient standards by turn 18, including automated patch deployment, runtime anomaly detection, and fallback protocols — **in flight**
